title: Structure-Aware Message Passing on Petri Nets through Directed Walks and Incidence Diffusion
abstract: arXiv:2610.29725v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A common application of the process mining discipline is to connect observed event data with Petri nets, which are bipartite, directed graphical process models with rich formal underpinnings. Recent work learns vector representations of Petri nets to retrieve process models and relate them to event logs, but leaves implicit two key aspects hidden within the net's structure: directed cycles (process loops) and invariants recorded by the net's incidence matrix. We expose both of these to message-passing graph neural networks, through a positional encoding built from return probabilities of directed place-transition walks (PNRWPE), and through same-type messages gated by diffusion kernels of the incidence matrix (DA-PNGNN). translated_title: 通过有向游走与关联扩散实现佩特网上的结构感知消息传递
translated_abstract: 过程挖掘学科的一个常见应用是将观测到的事件数据与佩特网关联起来，佩特网是一种具有丰富形式化基础的二部有向图形化过程模型。近期的工作学习了佩特网的向量表示以检索过程模型并将其与事件日志相关联，但隐式地忽略了隐藏在网络结构中的两个关键方面：有向循环（过程回路）和由网络关联矩阵记录的不变量。我们通过基于有向库所-变迁游走返回概率构建的位置编码（PNRWPE），以及通过由关联矩阵扩散内核门控的同类型消息（DA-PNGNN），将这两个方面显式地呈现给消息传递图神经网络。我们的构造将预测96个过程发现竞赛2023模型生成因子的宏平衡准确率从0.751提升至0.796（使用PNRWPE），这几乎使过程回路上的准确率翻倍，并进一步（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出PNRWPE位置编码和DA-PNGNN两种结构感知机制，使图神经网络能够显式捕捉佩特网中的有向循环（过程回路）和关联矩阵不变量，将预测模型生成因子的宏平衡准确率从0.751提升至0.796，其中过程回路上的准确率几乎翻倍。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces PNRWPE positional encodings and DA-PNGNN to make message-passing GNNs structure-aware of directed cycles and incidence-matrix invariants in Petri nets, raising macro balanced accuracy in predicting model generation factors from 0.751 to 0.796 and nearly doubling accuracy on process loops.
